name: notehack
description: NoteHack — a calm, local-first notebook for ideas, knowledge, and publishing.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @notehack/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @notehack/server" "npm run dev -w @notehack/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @notehack/shared && npm run build -w @notehack/server && npm run build -w @notehack/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @notehack/server && npm run test -w @notehack/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @notehack/shared && npm run typecheck -w @notehack/server && npm run typecheck -w @notehack/web
